resetProtocols.freshRound: New isolated round; two neutral beacons, no channels/locks, tool purchase flags reset, distinct roundId; healthy connected actors at recorded valid fixture spawn; clear all QA targets and private logs after case. Model reset retains fixture coordinates and grants 500g, which is not the runtime reset contract.
resetProtocols.visibility: Fresh round; disable all other vision providers for negative probes, record providers for overlap probes; one target at a time; remove QA target and restore provider configuration afterward.
resetProtocols.persistence: Use dedicated isolated round; capture before/after roundId, owner/cycle/deadlines, switch purchase/readyAt/lockUntil; reconnect or restart must preserve round clocks; clear fixture with a new round after evidence.
resetProtocols.mobile: Fresh round on recorded real device/browser/orientation; restore UI scale, input capture and QA actor state; remove fixture after case.

Authoritative clock, tick duration, timestamp ordering, expiry-before-command policy, measured client latency and declared timing tolerance before observations

Real phone dimensions, safe-area/platform reserved rect, gesture event mapping, touch target requirement from canonical UI decision
